svg.title: Wasm-on-Kubernetes technology stack
svg.desc: Four-layer architecture showing how Wasm integrates with Kubernetes: orchestration platforms at top, node provisioning operators, containerd shims via runwasi, and low-level Wasm runtimes at the bottom.

g.text: Layer 4 — Application platforms (own the execution model)
